cards.explain_zh: 中考/CEFR 常用词：遭受；受苦
cards.example_en: Many people suffer from hay fever in late spring.
cards.example_zh: 晚春时节，许多人因花粉热而受苦。

cards.explain_zh: 中考/CEFR 常用词：想知道；惊奇
cards.example_en: I wonder why the bakery is closed this afternoon.
cards.example_zh: 我想知道这家面包店今天下午为什么关门。

cards.example_en: Nurses assist the doctor during the busy morning clinic.
cards.example_zh: 在忙碌的上午门诊里，护士协助医生。

cards.example_en: Few plants can survive without water.
cards.example_zh: 很少植物能在没有水的情况下存活。

cards.example_en: Dad forgot to mention the parent meeting at dinner.
cards.example_zh: 爸爸吃晚饭时忘了提及家长会。

cards.example_en: I am happy to accept your invitation.
cards.example_zh: 我很乐意接受您的邀请。

cards.example_en: The judges accord the winner a medal at the school fair.
cards.example_zh: 评委在学校游园会上给予胜者一枚奖牌。

cards.explain_zh: 中考/CEFR 常用词：添加；加
cards.example_en: Add some salt if the soup tastes too plain.
cards.example_zh: 如果汤太淡，就再加一点盐。

cards.explain_zh: 中考/CEFR 常用词：写上地址；处理
cards.example_en: Remember to address every envelope before the post office closes.
cards.example_zh: 邮局关门之前，记得给每个信封写上地址。

cards.explain_zh: 中考/CEFR 常用词：承认；准许进入
cards.example_en: You should admit breaking the window to your parents.
cards.example_zh: 你应该向父母承认，窗户是你打破的。

cards.example_en: Loud noise can affect your hearing at the concert.
cards.example_zh: 音乐会上的巨大噪声会影响你的听力。

cards.example_en: I agree with you about the plan.
My parents don't allow me to play games on school nights.
cards.example_zh: 我父母不允许我在上学日的晚上玩游戏。

cards.explain_zh: 中考/CEFR 常用词：申请；应用
cards.example_en: Graduates apply for summer jobs at the local hospital.
cards.example_zh: 毕业生向当地医院申请暑期工作。
